description: The VCL counterpart of 09_checkbox_caption_inside_container. A separate checkbox caption remains inside its visual white container after translation. The font floor here is nine points, not the ten this fixture inherited from its FireMonkey twin. That ten was the twin's thirteen converted arithmetically, and it does not survive contact with Windows metrics: the caption is 118 pixels of room inside its container and the Spanish needs about 130 at ten point, so a point has to come off. The twin keeps its size because FireMonkey draws the same words narrower. Nine is the readable floor, and the contract still holds the planner to it - it may not go below, and the text must fit.

known_overlaps.why: The caption grows leftward over the checkbox it belongs to, which is how it finds room for a longer translation - and is exactly the fault reported from the field, where an Arabic day name ended up under its own tick box. It is declared rather than fixed here because clipping the caption back off the checkbox costs it the width its text needs, and giving that width back requires the container to grow, which is a reordering of the fitting passes rather than a change to any one of them. Delete this declaration when that work lands; the contract will then prove it.
